messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> SELENE-DEDICATED-LATENCY (PD#45678). Trigger: reserved-pool-tail-latency > 1.2s for 2m. Impacting customer: SeleneHealth (dedicated pool selene-prod-01).

pagerduty: Incident 45678 created and notified: primary on-call Mike (Eng-Oncall).

Mike (Eng-Oncall): acked. looking now. any immediate blips in infra?

Ara (SRE): on it — checking scheduler and queue metrics. Preliminary: reserved pool showing heavy preemption and increased IO wait on host-gpu-23. Seeing elevated queue depth for selene-prod-01.

Lee (Platform): I can see autoscaler logs: `scale_down` attempted 4m ago but failed due to quota check failing; also an eviction storm on instance set `dedicated-gpu-a`. attaching recent metric window.

Mike (Eng-Oncall): running quick checks:
```
> rcli metrics get --pool selene-prod-01 --window 5m tail_latency
tail_95: 880ms
tail_99: 1.45s
errors_503: 78
requests/s: 210
```

Mike (Eng-Oncall): also pulling request logs to confirm 503s correlate with KV cache misses.

Ara (SRE): confirmed — KV cache eviction spikes at the same timestamps. Looks like we lost some node-local cache after instance churn. Candidate cause: recent maintenance job bumped capacity down in that AZ.

Lee (Platform): yes, there was a rolling maintenance bump that didn't respect reserved capacity locks for a small subset. I'm rolling that change back for selene-prod-01.

oncall-rotation: tagging next L2: @Ara please call if we need hands on infra rollback.

Mike (Eng-Oncall): mitigation steps in progress: 1) temporarily route new requests to selene-prod-02 (warm spare) 2) bump reserved capacity for selene-prod-01 by 20% 3) cancel maintenance rollback underway if needed.

Ara (SRE): doing failover now — updating routing policy.
```
> ctl route update --pool selene-prod --shift 30% --to selene-prod-02
```

Ara (SRE): routing change applied. monitor.log shows incoming traffic shifted. Request rate on selene-prod-02 rising, error rate dropping on selene-prod-01 slightly.

Mike (Eng-Oncall): bumping reserved capacity:
```
> infra-cli reserved-capacity set --pool selene-prod-01 --units 1200
```

Lee (Platform): reserved-capacity update accepted. autoscaler prevented further drains. rolling maintenance abort confirmed.

pagerduty: Mike (Eng-Oncall) acknowledged the incident at 3412001252. Incident escalations: not escalated to L2 yet.

Ara (SRE): after routing + capacity bump we see tail_99 now 460ms and 503s down to 6 in last 5m. Still watching KV cache rebuilds; some transient retries observed.

Mike (Eng-Oncall): good. notifying customer-facing SEs to let SeleneHealth know we have mitigations in place and are restoring normal behavior. Drafting message.

Lee (Platform): started a low-priority cache pre-warm job to repopulate KV caches on selene-prod-01 to speed steady-state recovery.

Mike (Eng-Oncall): customer msg draft: "We observed elevated latency and 503s in your dedicated cluster (selene-prod-01) due to an unexpected capacity change. We have rerouted traffic to your warm standby, increased reserved capacity, and aborted a maintenance job. We are running cache warm-up and monitor for 30m — no action required on your side. We will follow up with a post-incident summary." Any edits?

Ara (SRE): add ETA for post-incident: ~2h for full cache stabilization. and note metrics we tracked (tail_99, errors).

Mike (Eng-Oncall): sent to SEs at 3412001320.

oncall-rotation: tagging oncall handoff: Mike will stay until 3412001400 then hand off to Ara for overnight watch.

Mike (Eng-Oncall): will do a quick runbook check to ensure no regressions:
- confirm no other pools received maintenance flags
- verify client retries under SLOs
- leave bridging notes

Ara (SRE): quick incident notes: cause: maintenance quota/lock mismatch -> instance churn -> KV cache eviction -> tail latency increase + 503s. mitigations: aborted maintenance, routing shift to warm spare, capacity bump, cache pre-warm. follow-ups: add a preflight that checks reserved locks before maintenance; add an alert that correlates cache-eviction spikes with maintenance-tags.

Lee (Platform): opening follow-up ticket: PLAT-7892 (ensure maintenance respects reserved locks). I linked autoscaler logs and the commands we ran.

pagerduty: No further pages issued. Incident remains acknowledged.

Mike (Eng-Oncall): monitoring looks stable for now. I'll mark incident as "stabilized" and defer full RCA to follow-up.

Ara (SRE): taking overnight watch. Will escalate to on-call rotation if we see >5% error rate for 10m.

Mike (Eng-Oncall): marking stabilized at 3412001490. final check in 10m then handoff.

oncall-rotation: handoff to Ara completed at 3412001525.

Ara (SRE): last note before leaving: keep an eye on cache warm-up progress and any autoscaler anomalies. Will pick up tomorrow for RCA. :white_check_mark:
